issue.title: Show copy-chip faces, not raw copy[label]: source, on plain-text task surfaces

task_type_fields.proposal: Plain-text task surfaces render a task's raw line text, so a row like **Start last week's review draft** shows ``copy[last-week prompt]: Update the last-week period note (`bob periods show last-week` prints its path)`` verbatim. Affected surfaces: task pickers in bob-navigation-hotkeys and bob-ledger-tools, the Task Card title, the ]s walk toast, and the Bob Mac Capture agenda (which reads bob's JSON, so the face belongs in bob-cli per decisions:mac-capture-is-a-thin-client). Proposed fix: add a pure face helper to bob-copy-chips' api.copyChips (for example face(line) mapping each chip span to its label, or to its text when unlabeled) for the Obsidian surfaces, plus a matching face function in bob-cli's task display text, both pinned to bob-plugins scripts/fixtures/copy-chips-vectors.json. Payloads stay in the source line; only display text changes.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The copy-chips epic bob-cli-ni (plan:202611/copy_chips.md) excluded any bob-cli or Mac Capture change and listed this exact item under its adopt phase's proposed follow-ups.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by bob-cli-ni.6 (note #3): the copy-chips epic turned the gtd_daily.md review prompts into chips, and plain-text task surfaces now show their raw Markdown. The bob-cli-ni land agent filed it as the plan's recorded follow-up.
